admission.justification: Recording a hand-made memory commit from a closed flag alone would admit unanswered invariant work.

applicability: Recorded landing of a converted leaf pair, in dry run and apply.
conditions: A named recorded memory base is present.
Code is the recorded closeout commit when the landed code descends from it, otherwise the landed code.
exclusions: A missing memory base is refusal, not permission to use landed parents.
statement: record_landing re-judges the pair through rule 1 before recording anything, dry run included; missing memory base refuses by name.
